svg.title: XOR-like filter merge
svg.desc: Each dataset contains six k-mers, of which four, highlighted blue, are shared. The shared fraction is two thirds of each document, with Jaccard similarity one half. Before merging, the two 16-slot filters each store eight-bit cells, totaling 256 bits. After rebuilding a filter on the eight-key union, each of its 16 cells has eight fingerprint bits and two encoded origin bits, totaling 160 bits. XOR lookup recovers one fingerprint and the correct membership for every union key. The saving is 96 bits or 37.5 percent. Arrays are actual checked toy filter cells; the merge arrow is not a bitwise XOR of the old arrays. Counts exclude metadata, padding, compression and auxiliary structures. The same GATCA query is shown before and after merging. Its selected slots 4,12,15 are highlighted blue. Before merging, their XOR reconstructs 10101100 for D1 and a different fingerprint for D2, giving membership 1,0. After merging, XOR reconstructs fingerprint 10101100 and origin bits 1,0, giving the same answer.
